# Agent Router: Easy SSH Tunnel Manager

Router for Easy SSH Tunnel Manager, a GTK 3 app for SSH tunnels on
Linux. The profile lives in the vault.

## Always Read In This Order

1. `../workspace-wiki/agents/README.md`: the shared reading chain of the ProjectMakers vault
2. `../workspace-wiki/projects/easysshtunnel/README.md`: this project's page in the vault
3. [README.md](README.md): features, install and usage
4. [docs/agent-notes.md](docs/agent-notes.md): architecture notes for agents

If `../workspace-wiki` is missing, clone the vault there first. Without it the shared
half of the rules is missing. The vault is private, its clone URL is in the
router of every private ProjectMakers repository.
